description:
Jane Bryant, the youngest daughter of one of the Empire’s most powerful noble families and its leading merchant guild, has a rather unusual personality: despite being well past the usual marriageable age, she still has no intention of getting married.

But Jane has a secret hobby she could never tell anyone about. 

And that hobby is none other than… ~𝑯𝒂𝒑𝒑𝒚 𝑻𝒊𝒎𝒆\~ 

One day, while enjoying her usual “Happy Time,” her expensive vibrating magic device suddenly breaks down just before she reaches climax. Enraged, Jane disguises herself as a commoner and storms into the shop to complain. 

But there, she ends up having an unexpected one-night encounter with Rowen, a mage whose body is exceptionally sensitive to magic. 

Then she discovers an even more surprising truth: 

Rowen is the developer who makes the shop’s adult magic devices?! 

“Go into business with me!” 

With Jane’s eyes sparkling with curiosity and excitement and the painfully shy Rowen by her side, just how will the business venture between these two unfold?

[Original Webtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/Lady_J)
